summary: Data-driven composition of the existing AchievementBadge and AchievementBadgeGroup components.
whenToUse: Showing a collection of earned or locked badges from a typed array.
whenNotToUse: Replacing AchievementBadge for a single achievement.
Replicating badges with different styles or logic.

props.name: minItemWidth
props.description: Minimum width of the responsive columns.

inherits: HTML attributes of <ul>. BadgeCollectionItem adds id to the AchievementBadge props.
accessibility: Reuses the semantic list and accessible labels provided by AchievementBadgeGroup and AchievementBadge.
responsive: The auto-fill grid and minItemWidth are handled by AchievementBadgeGroup.
customization: All visuals and tokens come from AchievementBadge and AchievementBadgeGroup.
commonMistakes: Forgetting a stable id for items or reusing duplicate ids.
limits: Adds no duplicate badge styles or logic.
